items.subject: The square of Hollowmere, a fog-bound Cornish harbour hamlet in autumn 1931, at night: granite cobbles around a timber-framed meeting bell and a stone well pump, four iron lantern posts throwing warm pools, plaster-and-slate cottages with lit windows, a tarred net loft and the dock beyond, sea fog rolling in cold blue

The Drowned Lantern's bar room as a cutaway room: a long oak bar with kegs, a stone hearth blazing, two oil lamps, low beams hung with nets and floats, scuffed floorboards, plaster over brick, empty tables with tankards
Gallows Wood at night: a trail two tiles wide through dense oaks and silver birches, bracken and fallen leaves, a small clearing in moonlight, a lantern on a gate post at the wood's edge
Vane's flooded tin gallery: timber cribs and wet granite, a broken beam pumping engine under a shaft of grey daylight, black water glowing faint teal with mould, an ore cart on rails, one oil lamp

A 1931 logging camp in a black-pine valley at night: a long log bunkhouse with a porch, a plank sawmill with a waterwheel, a yard with a shift bell under a pole gallows and a pump, lantern posts, mud and sawdust, a cliff with a timbered mine adit behind
The Blackpine tin workings: a timbered adit with tram rails, an ore chamber lit by candles stuck to the rock and one lamp by a chalked tally board, powder kegs, rust ore streaks in grey rock
